title: The Insane Story Behind Horacio Pagani
description:
When Horacio Pagani arrived in Italy, Lamborghini had withdrawn its job offer. According to a published interview, he took any work he could find: florist, steel welder. He and his wife lived in a tent for a few months. Eventually Lamborghini hired him as a laborer, the lowest entry-level role in the company. Today, his name is on some of the most expensive cars in the world. This is the insane story behind Horacio Pagani. Here is the twist. A letter from a world champion opened the door in Italy, a bank loan bought an oven that his employer refused to buy, and a Mercedes engineer was shown a workshop where friends in work coats had been asked to pretend to be a larger company. All of it is in published sources, and all of it is true as far as we can verify.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
